mapper.select: SELECT id,repo_id,original_name,media_type,size_bytes,sha256,storage_path,scan_status,created_at FROM knowledge_attachments WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT a.id,a.repo_id,a.original_name,a.media_type,a.size_bytes,a.sha256,a.scan_status,a.created_at FROM knowledge_card_attachment_refs r JOIN knowledge_attachments a ON a.id=r.attachment_id JOIN knowledge_cards c ON c.id=r.card_id WHERE c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND r.card_id=#{cardId} AND r.revision=#{revision} ORDER BY r.position,a.created_at,a.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_card_attachment_refs WHERE card_id=#{cardId} AND revision=#{revision}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.size_bytes),0) FROM knowledge_card_attachment_refs r JOIN knowledge_attachments a ON a.id=r.attachment_id WHERE r.card_id=#{cardId} AND r.revision=#{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_card_attachment_refs(card_id,revision,attachment_id,position) SELECT #{cardId},#{revision},a.id,#{position} FROM knowledge_attachments a JOIN knowledge_cards c ON c.id=#{cardId} WHERE a.id=#{attachmentId} AND a.repo_id=c.repo_id ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
